examples.english: If you don’t want to go, you can cancel the appointment.

examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù hěn kuān.
examples.english: This road is very wide.

examples.pinyin: Bǎ mén kāi kuān yìdiǎn.
examples.english: Open the door a little wider.

examples.pinyin: Tā de xīnxiōng hěn kuān.
examples.english: He is broad-minded.

english: in contrast/disagreement: actually; rather; on the contrary

examples.pinyin: Wǒ dào juéde bù yídìng.
examples.english: I actually don’t think that’s necessarily true.

examples.chinese: 你说得有道理，我倒觉得还有别的可能。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de yǒu dàoli, wǒ dào juéde hái yǒu bié de kěnéng.
examples.english: What you said makes sense, but I actually think there are other possibilities.

examples.chinese: 他倒不是不想去，只是没时间。
examples.pinyin: Tā dào bú shì bù xiǎng qù, zhǐshì méi shíjiān.
examples.english: It’s not that he doesn’t want to go; rather, he just doesn’t have time.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng gěi wǒ yí ge lìzi ma?
examples.english: Can you give me an example?

examples.pinyin: Zhège lìzi hěn jiǎndān.
examples.english: This example is very simple.

examples.chinese: 我不太明白，你再举个例子吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú tài míngbai, nǐ zài jǔ ge lìzi ba.
examples.english: I don’t quite understand. Give another example.

english: old fox; sly/cunning and experienced person

examples.chinese: 他可是个老狐狸，没那么容易被骗。
examples.pinyin: Tā kě shì ge lǎo húli, méi nàme róngyì bèi piàn.
examples.english: He’s a real old fox; he’s not easy to fool.

examples.chinese: 你别装了，你这个老狐狸！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié zhuāng le, nǐ zhège lǎo húli!
examples.english: Stop pretending, you sly old fox!

examples.chinese: 那个老狐狸早就看出来了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge lǎo húli zǎo jiù kàn chūlái le.
examples.english: That old fox had figured it out long ago.

english: to encounter; to run into; to meet

examples.chinese: 我昨天遇到一个老朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān yùdào yí ge lǎo péngyou.
examples.english: I ran into an old friend yesterday.

examples.pinyin: Yùdào wèntí bú yào hàipà.
examples.english: Don’t be afraid when you encounter a problem.

examples.chinese: 我们在路上遇到了堵车。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài lùshang yùdào le dǔchē.
examples.english: We encountered a traffic jam on the road.

english: how; in what way; how to

examples.chinese: 你打算如何解决这个问题？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dǎsuàn rúhé jiějué zhège wèntí?
examples.english: How do you plan to solve this problem?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào gāi rúhé huídá.
examples.english: I don’t know how to answer.

examples.chinese: 你认为我们应该如何处理？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ rènwéi wǒmen yīnggāi rúhé chǔlǐ?
examples.english: How do you think we should handle this?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ gǎndào wúbǐ xìngfú.
examples.english: I feel incredibly happy.

examples.chinese: 他对自己的成绩感到无比自豪。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì zìjǐ de chéngjì gǎndào wúbǐ zìháo.
examples.english: He feels immensely proud of his achievements.

examples.chinese: 这个消息让她无比震惊。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoxi ràng tā wúbǐ zhènjīng.
examples.english: The news shocked her immensely.

english: keep it; leave it there; save it for later

examples.chinese: 这个你留着吧，以后可能有用。
examples.pinyin: Zhège nǐ liúzhe ba, yǐhòu kěnéng yǒuyòng.
examples.english: Keep this; it might be useful later.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng piào bié rēng, liúzhe.
examples.english: Don’t throw away this ticket. Keep it.

examples.pinyin: Qián xiān liúzhe, yǐhòu zài yòng.
examples.english: Save the money for now and use it later.

examples.chinese: 警察正在调查这起案件。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá zhèngzài diàochá zhè qǐ ànjiàn.
examples.english: The police are investigating this case.

examples.chinese: 我们需要调查事情的真相。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào diàochá shìqing de zhēnxiàng.
examples.english: We need to investigate the truth of what happened.

examples.pinyin: Jǐngfāng diàochá le xiànchǎng.
examples.english: The police investigated the scene.

english: to mark/correct; grade and correct work

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī zhèngzài pīgǎi zuòyè.
examples.english: The teacher is marking the homework.

examples.chinese: 老师昨天批改了我们的试卷。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī zuótiān pīgǎi le wǒmen de shìjuàn.
examples.english: The teacher marked our exam papers yesterday.

examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē zuòwén hái méi pīgǎi wán.
examples.english: These essays haven’t been marked yet.

examples.pinyin: Tā liúzhe yì tiáo cháng biànzi.
examples.english: She has a long braid.

examples.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài gěi nǚ'ér zā biànzi.
examples.english: She is braiding her daughter’s hair.

examples.pinyin: Zhège nǚhái yǒu liǎng tiáo biànzi.
examples.english: This girl has two braids.

examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de píngfēn hěn gāo.
examples.english: This movie has a high rating.

examples.chinese: 你给这部电视剧评分多少？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ gěi zhè bù diànshìjù píngfēn duōshao?
examples.english: What rating would you give this TV series?

examples.chinese: 老师正在给我们的作业评分。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī zhèngzài gěi wǒmen de zuòyè píngfēn.
examples.english: The teacher is grading our homework.

examples.pinyin: Tā zhǐshì yí ge píngfán de rén.
examples.english: He is just an ordinary person.

examples.chinese: 我希望过平凡而幸福的生活。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng guò píngfán ér xìngfú de shēnghuó.
examples.english: I hope to live an ordinary but happy life.

examples.chinese: 看起来很平凡，其实很不简单。
examples.pinyin: Kàn qǐlái hěn píngfán, qíshí hěn bù jiǎndān.
examples.english: It looks ordinary, but it’s actually far from simple.

english: step/stair; figuratively a way out or room to save face

examples.pinyin: Xiǎoxīn, qiánmiàn yǒu táijiē.
examples.english: Careful, there’s a step ahead.

examples.pinyin: Tā mànmàn zǒu xià táijiē.
examples.english: He slowly walked down the steps.

examples.pinyin: Gěi tā ge táijiē xià ba.
examples.english: Give him a way to back down gracefully.

pinyin: chī yí qiàn, zhǎng yí zhì
english: learn from one’s mistakes; a setback makes one wiser

examples.chinese: 这次失败让我吃一堑，长一智。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shībài ràng wǒ chī yí qiàn, zhǎng yí zhì.
examples.english: This failure taught me a lesson.

examples.chinese: 别太难过，吃一堑，长一智。
examples.pinyin: Bié tài nánguò, chī yí qiàn, zhǎng yí zhì.
examples.english: Don’t be too upset. Learn from the experience.

examples.chinese: 这次被骗以后，他终于吃一堑，长一智了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì bèi piàn yǐhòu, tā zhōngyú chī yí qiàn, zhǎng yí zhì le.
examples.english: After being scammed this time, he finally learned his lesson.

examples.chinese: 写论文的时候要正确引用资料。
examples.pinyin: Xiě lùnwén de shíhou yào zhèngquè yǐnyòng zīliào.
examples.english: When writing a paper, you need to cite sources correctly.

examples.chinese: 他经常引用名人的话来支持自己的观点。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīngcháng yǐnyòng míngrén de huà lái zhīchí zìjǐ de guāndiǎn.
examples.english: He often quotes famous people to support his views.

examples.chinese: 这篇文章引用了很多历史资料。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng yǐnyòng le hěn duō lìshǐ zīliào.
examples.english: This article cites a lot of historical sources.

examples.chinese: 大家都在内卷，谁也不敢放松。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zài nèijuǎn, shéi yě bù gǎn fàngsōng.
examples.english: Everyone is caught up in the rat race, and nobody dares to relax.

examples.chinese: 为了考高分，学生们越来越内卷。
examples.pinyin: Wèile kǎo gāofēn, xuéshengmen yuèláiyuè nèijuǎn.
examples.english: To get high scores, the students are becoming increasingly caught up in excessive competition.

examples.pinyin: Bié zài nèijuǎn le, zǎodiǎn shuì ba.
examples.english: Stop competing so obsessively and go to bed earlier.

english: opposite; contrary; conversely; on the contrary

examples.pinyin: Tāmen de guāndiǎn wánquán xiāngfǎn.
examples.english: Their views are completely opposite.

examples.chinese: 我不觉得他很冷漠，相反，他非常热心。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù juéde tā hěn lěngmò, xiāngfǎn, tā fēicháng rèxīn.
examples.english: I don’t think he’s cold-hearted. On the contrary, he’s very warm-hearted.

examples.chinese: 他的做法看起来很冒险，相反，另一个方案更加稳妥。
examples.pinyin: Tā de zuòfǎ kàn qǐlái hěn màoxiǎn, xiāngfǎn, lìng yí ge fāng'àn gèng jiā wěntuǒ.
examples.english: His approach looks risky; by contrast, the other plan is more cautious.

english: to break through; make a breakthrough; overcome

examples.chinese: 我们终于突破了这个技术难题。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhōngyú tūpò le zhège jìshù nántí.
examples.english: We finally overcame this technical challenge.

examples.chinese: 他在比赛中突破了自己的最好成绩。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài bǐsài zhōng tūpò le zìjǐ de zuì hǎo chéngjì.
examples.english: He surpassed his previous best performance in the competition.

examples.chinese: 这个项目取得了重大突破。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù qǔdé le zhòngdà tūpò.
examples.english: This project achieved a major breakthrough.

english: make trouble; cause trouble; mess around

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié zài zhèlǐ dǎluàn.
examples.english: Don’t cause trouble here.

examples.chinese: 孩子们一来就喜欢捣乱。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen yì lái jiù xǐhuan dǎluàn.
examples.english: Whenever the kids come, they like to mess around.

examples.chinese: 别在别人工作的时候捣乱。
examples.pinyin: Bié zài biérén gōngzuò de shíhou dǎluàn.
examples.english: Don’t cause trouble while other people are working.

english: obediently; nicely; be a good kid

examples.pinyin: Nǐ guāiguāi zài jiā děng wǒ.
examples.english: Stay home and wait for me.

examples.pinyin: Guāiguāi zuòzhe, bié luàn pǎo.
examples.english: Sit nicely and don’t run around.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān guāiguāi chīfàn.
examples.english: Be a good kid and eat first.

examples.pinyin: Tāmen shì yí ge yīnyuè zǔhé.
examples.english: They are a musical group.

examples.pinyin: Zhège zǔhé yǒu sì ge chéngyuán.
examples.english: This group has four members.

examples.pinyin: Zhège yánsè zǔhé hěn hǎokàn.
examples.english: This color combination looks good.

examples.pinyin: Xiàwǔ wǒmen yào cǎipái.
examples.english: We have rehearsal this afternoon.

examples.pinyin: Cǎipái nèiróng línshí gǎi le.
examples.english: The rehearsal material was changed at the last minute.

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā zhèngzài wèi yǎnchū cǎipái.
examples.english: Everyone is rehearsing for the performance.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ suíyì kànkan.
examples.english: You can have a look around.

examples.pinyin: Bú yào suíyì gǎibiàn jìhuà.
examples.english: Don’t change the plan arbitrarily.

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā suíyì zuò ba.
examples.english: Everyone, sit wherever you like.

examples.pinyin: Tāmen zhèngzài lùzhì jiémù.
examples.english: They are recording a program.

examples.pinyin: Jiémù lùzhì hái méi jiéshù.
examples.english: The program recording isn’t finished yet.

examples.chinese: 我们下午录制一个视频。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ lùzhì yí ge shìpín.
examples.english: We are recording a video this afternoon.

examples.pinyin: Shàngkè qījiān bù néng wán shǒujī.
examples.english: You can’t use your phone during class.

examples.chinese: 在旅行期间我拍了很多照片。
examples.pinyin: Zài lǚxíng qījiān wǒ pāi le hěn duō zhàopiàn.
examples.english: I took many photos during the trip.

examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì qījiān dàjiā dōu hěn máng.
examples.english: Everyone is very busy during exam period.

examples.pinyin: Nàge rén kàn qǐlái hěn kěyí.
examples.english: That person looks suspicious.

examples.pinyin: Méi fāxiàn kěyí rényuán.
examples.english: No suspicious person was found.

examples.pinyin: Tā de xíngwéi hěn kěyí.
examples.english: His behavior is very suspicious.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn yíxià jiānkòng.
examples.english: Check the surveillance footage.

examples.pinyin: Jiānkòng pāi dào le tā.
examples.english: The security camera caught him.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān chá jiānkòng.
examples.english: Let’s check the surveillance footage first.

examples.pinyin: Tā de biǎoqíng hěn píngjìng.
examples.english: His expression is very calm.

examples.chinese: 发生这种事以后，她还是很平静。
examples.pinyin: Fāshēng zhè zhǒng shì yǐhòu, tā háishi hěn píngjìng.
examples.english: Even after that happened, she remained calm.

examples.chinese: 你先冷静一点，保持平静。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān lěngjìng yìdiǎn, bǎochí píngjìng.
examples.english: Calm down a little and stay composed.

examples.pinyin: Tā bú shì kèyì zhème zuò de.
examples.english: He didn’t do it intentionally.

examples.chinese: 她刻意避开了这个问题。
examples.pinyin: Tā kèyì bìkāi le zhège wèntí.
examples.english: She deliberately avoided this issue.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu kèyì yǐnmán.
examples.english: I didn’t deliberately hide it.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhōumò yào dǎsǎo fángjiān.
examples.english: I need to clean my room this weekend.

examples.chinese: 她每天早上打扫办公室。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān zǎoshang dǎsǎo bàngōngshì.
examples.english: She cleans the office every morning.

examples.pinyin: Xiān bǎ zhuōzi dǎsǎo gānjìng.
examples.english: Clean the table first.

english: what if; in case; should something unexpected happen

examples.pinyin: Wànyī chídào le zěnme bàn?
examples.english: What if we’re late?

examples.pinyin: Dài bǎ sǎn ba, wànyī xiàyǔ ne?
examples.english: Take an umbrella, in case it rains.

examples.pinyin: Wànyī tā bù tóngyì ne?
examples.english: What if he doesn’t agree?

english: have no choice but to; be forced to

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bùdébù huíqù le.
examples.english: I have no choice but to go back.

examples.chinese: 下雨了，我们不得不取消计划。
examples.pinyin: Xiàyǔ le, wǒmen bùdébù qǔxiāo jìhuà.
examples.english: It rained, so we had to cancel the plan.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bùdébù chóngxīn kāishǐ.
examples.english: I had no choice but to start over.

examples.pinyin: Tiān jiànjiàn liàng le.
examples.english: It gradually became light.

examples.chinese: 我渐渐习惯了这里的生活。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiànjiàn xíguàn le zhèlǐ de shēnghuó.
examples.english: I gradually got used to life here.

examples.pinyin: Yǔ jiànjiàn tíng le.
examples.english: The rain gradually stopped.

english: attach importance to; value; take seriously

examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn zhòngshì zhè cì jīhuì.
examples.english: I really value this opportunity.

examples.chinese: 公司非常重视安全问题。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī fēicháng zhòngshì ānquán wèntí.
examples.english: The company takes safety issues very seriously.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zhòngshì zhège wèntí.
examples.english: We need to take this issue seriously.

examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de tiānqì bú tài lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: Today’s weather isn’t ideal.

examples.chinese: 结果比我们想象的更理想。
examples.pinyin: Jiéguǒ bǐ wǒmen xiǎngxiàng de gèng lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: The result was better than we expected.

examples.chinese: 这个方案的效果不太理想。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fāng’àn de xiàoguǒ bú tài lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: The result of this plan is not very satisfactory.

examples.chinese: 他在那里停留了十分钟。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài nàlǐ tíngliú le shí fēnzhōng.
examples.english: He stayed there for ten minutes.

examples.pinyin: Bú yào zài ménkǒu tíngliú.
examples.english: Don’t linger at the entrance.

examples.chinese: 我只在那里停留了一晚。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ zài nàlǐ tíngliú le yì wǎn.
examples.english: I only stayed there for one night.

examples.chinese: 我等了你整整一个小时。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ děng le nǐ zhěngzhěng yí ge xiǎoshí.
examples.english: I waited for you for a full hour.

examples.chinese: 他整整睡了十二个小时。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhěngzhěng shuì le shí’èr ge xiǎoshí.
examples.english: He slept for a full twelve hours.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zǒu le zhěngzhěng yì tiān.
examples.english: We walked for an entire day.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ hái zài yóuyù yào bú yào qù.
examples.english: I’m still deciding whether to go.

examples.pinyin: Bié yóuyù le, kuài zǒu ba.
examples.english: Don’t hesitate anymore; let’s go.

examples.pinyin: Tā yóuyù le yíxià cái huídá.
examples.english: She hesitated for a moment before answering.

english: strive for; fight for; try to obtain

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào zhēngqǔ zhège jīhuì.
examples.english: I want to fight for this opportunity.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhēngqǔ míngtiān wánchéng.
examples.english: We’ll try our best to finish tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 她一直在争取更多时间。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìzhí zài zhēngqǔ gèng duō shíjiān.
examples.english: She has been trying to gain more time.

examples.pinyin: Tā tūrán yūndǎo le.
examples.english: He suddenly fainted.

examples.chinese: 她昨天在办公室晕倒了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuótiān zài bàngōngshì yūndǎo le.
examples.english: She fainted at the office yesterday.

examples.pinyin: Tā chàdiǎn yūndǎo.
examples.english: He almost fainted.

examples.pinyin: Tiān tūránjiān hēi le.
examples.english: It suddenly became dark.

examples.pinyin: Tā tūránjiān bù shuōhuà le.
examples.english: He suddenly stopped talking.

examples.pinyin: Tā tūránjiān xiào le.
examples.english: She suddenly laughed.

english: by all means; definitely; whatever you do

examples.pinyin: Qiānwàn bié gàosu tā.
examples.english: Whatever you do, don’t tell him.

examples.pinyin: Qiānwàn bú yào chídào.
examples.english: Whatever you do, don’t be late.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì nǐ qiānwàn yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: Be very careful about this.

examples.chinese: 市面上有很多类似的产品。
examples.pinyin: Shìmiàn shàng yǒu hěn duō lèisì de chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: There are many similar products on the market.

examples.chinese: 这种产品市面上还没有。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng chǎnpǐn shìmiàn shàng hái méiyǒu.
examples.english: This product isn’t on the market yet.

examples.chinese: 市面上很难找到这种配件。
examples.pinyin: Shìmiàn shàng hěn nán zhǎodào zhè zhǒng pèijiàn.
examples.english: It’s hard to find this kind of part on the market.

english: enter and leave; go in and out

examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ jìnzhǐ chūrù.
examples.english: Entry and exit are prohibited here.

examples.chinese: 他可以随意出入办公室。
examples.pinyin: Tā kěyǐ suíyì chūrù bàngōngshì.
examples.english: He can freely enter and leave the office.

examples.pinyin: Rényuán chūrù yào dēngjì.
examples.english: People entering and leaving have to register.

examples.pinyin: Zhè shì ge yúchǔn de juédìng.
examples.english: This is a foolish decision.

examples.pinyin: Bú yào zuò zhème yúchǔn de shì.
examples.english: Don’t do something so stupid.

examples.chinese: 我承认这个想法有点愚蠢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chéngrèn zhège xiǎngfǎ yǒudiǎn yúchǔn.
examples.english: I admit this idea is a little foolish.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ píng shénme zhème shuō?
examples.english: What gives you the right to say that?

examples.pinyin: Píng shénme wǒ yào tīng nǐ de?
examples.english: Why should I listen to you?

examples.pinyin: Nǐ píng shénme bù ràng wǒ jìnqù?
examples.english: Why won’t you let me go in?

english: have nothing to do with me

examples.pinyin: Zhè gēn wǒ méiyǒu guānxi.
examples.english: This has nothing to do with me.

examples.pinyin: Nà jiàn shì gēn wǒ méiyǒu guānxi.
examples.english: That matter has nothing to do with me.

examples.chinese: 你们的争论跟我没有关系。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen de zhēnglùn gēn wǒ méiyǒu guānxi.
examples.english: Your argument has nothing to do with me.

english: would I really…?; do you really think I would…?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ hái zhìyú piàn nǐ ma?
examples.english: Would I really lie to you?

examples.chinese: 我还至于因为这点小事生气吗？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hái zhìyú yīnwèi zhè diǎn xiǎoshì shēngqì ma?
examples.english: Would I really get angry over such a small thing?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ hái zhìyú zhème zuò ma?
examples.english: Would I really do something like that?

english: do/get something done properly; do something well

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yídìng bǎ zhè jiàn shì zuò hǎo.
examples.english: I’ll make sure to do this properly.

examples.pinyin: Xiān bǎ gōngzuò zuò hǎo.
examples.english: First, get the work done properly.

examples.chinese: 我们要把这个项目做好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào bǎ zhège xiàngmù zuò hǎo.
examples.english: We need to do this project properly.

english: still have to; still need to

examples.pinyin: Wǒ hái děi gōngzuò.
examples.english: I still have to work.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ hái děi huíqù yí tàng.
examples.english: I still have to go back once.

examples.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ hái děi xuéxí.
examples.english: I still have to study today.
